name: assessments_recent_activity
description: Recent assessment activity, most recent first (metadata only, no rating values): ratings, evidence, comments, and alignment milestones started, completed and re-opened against any role (role_id, role_code, role_name, home). Covers the caller and their whole org subtree; person_id narrows to one person whose assessment the caller may view, and then alignment milestones come from the event stream, so a completion later re-opened still appears. since / until (ISO 8601; a bare date is its UTC day, inclusive; a date-time needs an offset) bound the window, applied before the limit. Ratings and alignment rows keep only each cell's or role's latest stamp, so a window misses activity later overwritten (with person_id, alignments are read in full from the stream). cycle_id keeps one cycle's activity (comments carry no cycle and are left out). kinds narrows by kind; an empty list returns none. limit defaults to 8, at most 50.

since.description: ISO 8601 date-time, or a date for the start of that UTC day.

until.description: ISO 8601 date-time, or a date for the end of that UTC day.

cycle_id.description: An assessment cycle's id, from reporting_cycles_list.

kinds.description: Keep only these kinds of activity.
